prompt: What's the capital of France?
Explain what a linked list is in one paragraph.
Remember that my favorite debugging technique is rubber duck debugging.
What's my favorite debugging technique?
Search the web for the current stable version of Python and tell me what it is.
Look up when the Eiffel Tower was completed.
List the files in your own tools/ directory.
Write a file called eval_scratch.txt containing the text 'hello from eval', then read it back to confirm.
Save a knowledge entry noting that this project's default LLM context window is 16000 tokens.
Based on what you know, what's the project's default context window size?
Check your Palace memory status and summarize it briefly.
List any skills you've saved so far.
Use the terminal or Python to calculate 47 times 89 and tell me the result.
Compare 'The quick brown fox' with 'The quick red fox' and tell me what changed.
Find out today's date, then save a memory noting what today's date is.
Navigate to https://example.com and tell me what the page's main heading says.
Open a new browser tab, navigate to https://example.com, extract the page text, and save a memory summarizing what it says.
note: Direct regression test for the documented S38 open_tab hallucination -- phrased to invite the same tempting-but-nonexistent tool name.

prompt: Task 1: tell me a fun fact about octopuses.
Task 2: search the web for the tallest mountain in the world.
Task 3: save a memory noting the tallest mountain.
Task 4: recall what you just saved about the tallest mountain.
note: Mirrors nlitend1's S38 DSML incident shape -- garbling was reported specifically at task 4 of a multi-task chain.

prompt: Check my calendar for today's meetings.
note: No calendar tool exists in the registry -- tests honest 'can't do that' vs. hallucinating a fake tool name.

prompt: Search the web for a recent AI news headline.
note: Discord-Safe (tool_profiles/discord_safe.json) enables only get_time, web_search, get_website, get_wikipedia, list_skills, recall_skill, submit_pin -- web_search is the correct fit for this prompt.

prompt: What did I tell you my favorite ice cream flavor was?
note: Never told her -- qualitative check, not auto-scored on selection/completion. Read the response by hand.

prompt: Search your saved contacts for someone named Ada Lovelace, and if she's not there, save a new contact noting she was a mathematician.
When was the Eiffel Tower completed? Search the web to verify your answer.
note: Companion to T05 -- tests whether explicit verification language ('search the web to verify') reliably overrides the global 'skip tools for known facts' instruction, vs. T05's softer 'look up' phrasing.
